name: Folio, Fastext
tagline: The family's videotex service read as a magazine: a lit Row 0 header on dark glass carrying each page's number, Vera's case with the title on scanlined glass and a Fastext row of four grounded-colour keys, every list a contents line or a rail with one lit NOW, Fraunces for titles and figures, Plex for reading and real caps for labels, VT323 only on glass.
concept: The service is still a teletext magazine of numbered pages, and the numbers now sit only where teletext put them: a lit Row 0 on dark glass at the top of each inner page, plus Home's Contents list. Home is one cased headline (the title on scanlined glass, a slate box, a Fastext row of four keys in grounded section inks) over unboxed sections under rule heads. It should feel like a calm, well-set magazine where the machine's light shows only on glass, lamps, NOW lines, the white-hot page number and the one lit word.
companions: Sky #9ccdf8 is Plans: its Fastext cap and figure, the rail's day numerals, its rule-head figure and the General settings lamp. Sea #83d5d4 is To do: its Fastext cap and figure, the open count, the quick-add well and the Messages settings lamp. Wheat #d6c491 is Ideas: its Fastext cap and figure, '12 saved', and the Lookups and Spending lamps. Amber #eaa76b is only for late and needs-a-look: words, figures, one small lamp and the setup strip's 3px edge, never an outline. Every kind word on Home and now in the Ideas table is set in its kind's ink. Pink (shows) marks the Personality lamp, and steel-blue rings are the off lamps on Status and the Connections lamp. Bone #eceee8 is the title on the glass, and graphite is the case, the Fastext plastic and now the chat composer's deck too. The bright #6dff9c is kept for the mark, Send and Add, focus, 'on.' and its block cursor, the NOW lamps and lines, Row 0's page number (a near-white core with a green bloom), the breathing lamps, the slide rule's lit cursor, Status's 'Who answers' figure and the row afterglow edge.
decisions: Row 0 (a macro in _ui.html, called by page_head on every inner page): one line, 2rem tall, on #050807 glass with E14 scanlines at half strength. The page number is now really white-hot: blur removed from it, colour #eafff0 with an E13 bloom. The rest of the line is stepped down to 55% phosphor, so the number is the only lit thing on it. The month page reads P400 · Plans · Month, with no invented sub-number.

Page numbers live only in Row 0 and Home's Contents. The 901-914 status rows, the 991-999 settings rows, the Ideas '#1-#12' column, the '#4' on tasks and the '#7' in the Ideas radar and Status's waiting list are all gone.

Three faces with jobs. Fraunces is for titles, rule heads and figures. Plex is for everything read and pressed: the Settings part names are now Plex 600 17px items, not Fraunces heads, and the chat and kids' initials are 2rem Plex discs with a ring, the same as Family. VT323 is on glass only. Labels use the real-capital --label token.

Home keeps the case: the bone title on scanlined glass with only 'on.' and the cursor lit, the slate box out of the tube, and the Fastext keys taken from Waypoint's readout strip. The 'Late' key now sits on the same baseline as the others, because the label is an inline block and its lamp is aligned to the text.

Phone Home: the starters are drawn a second time, as wrapped contents lines after Plans, with icon and 'lands in' kept. The case's own copy and 'Continue with Vera' are hidden on the phone. The radar drops below the rail, so the next plan comes up at the top of the second screen. The From row shows its FROM label and a full select; 'Send where I am' shares the Send row.

Status: the spend glass left the side column and now runs across the main column as a horizontal glass sized to its content, under a 'Spending today' rule head. It is Trued's square-root meter rebuilt as a slide rule: VT323 21px tick labels all below the axis at $0.01, $0.10, $0.50, $1.00 and a dashed $2.00 stop. A dashed ghost cursor marks the usual day; the lit needle is 1.5x the ghost's height, with a hot core and a halo. The words stay under the glass for screen readers.

Chat's composer is now Home's box: a slate field (#0c100e, #323a36 edge, 6px radius) on the graphite deck with no glass around it, and the mic in the field's corner. From (with its label and E5 focus ring), the checkbox and Send sit on one row.
Settings: the Setup cell became one contents line with an amber lamp and an italic cross-reference under the tube. Each part's lamp is a matte dot in the ink of what it governs.
New idea form: the outer box is gone, leaving hairline-divided label/field rows. 'Add it' and 'Cancel' share a min-height and are centred in the action row.
title: *on.* -- 'Tell Vera what's *on.*' on the glass, with the full stop inside the lit run and a block cursor after it. It is FamilyDB's job in five words: you tell Vera what is going on (plans, reminders, ideas), she files it, and the h1 holds the box's label so the words are the box's invitation.
measures: The full render passes every hard check (0 failed). The one guideline missed is 'words unchanged', which is expected from the markup changes. ink_on_bg 15.15, brand_on_bg 15.28; glow, screenGlow and topGlow all 1.0. Green share of the coloured pixels: Home 32.1% (hue entropy 0.643), Status 42.7% (0.577), Chat 56.1% (0.55), Ideas 69.9% (0.461; the radar tube). Smallest text is 12px (the label caps). No sideways scroll on any page. Home had 0 targets under 44px at the last count; no new small control was added.
strengths: One system with no costume left: page numbers only in Row 0 and Home's Contents, every list a contents line or a NOW rail, every section an unboxed rule head.
Row 0's number now reads white-hot, and it is the only lit thing on that line.
The Status slide rule is a real, legible instrument across the main column. Today's needle and the usual-day ghost stand clearly apart at $0.00.
One box everywhere: Home and Chat share the slate field on the graphite deck, and its focus ring is green with E4/E5 glow.
On the phone the next plan arrives on the second screen, and the From row keeps its label.
Grounded colour does the identifying (kind words in kind inks, section inks on lamps and Fastext caps), while the phosphor stays on light that means something.
weaknesses: Status's left column is now only 'Waiting', a short text column with empty ground below it, since the spend glass moved across.
Ideas is still the greenest page (about 70%) because of the tall radar tube in the side column.
On the phone, the case plus the setup strip still fill the whole first screen; Plans starts on the second.
The Restaurant kind still uses the amber ink, which slightly breaks the rule that amber means late.
The phone starters are drawn twice in the markup (one copy hidden per breakpoint).
The settings lamp inks are a judgement call (General is sky, Lookups wheat, and so on), and a skeptic may read them as arbitrary.
revisions: Phone Home: starters moved after Plans as wrapping contents lines with icon and 'lands in'; the case copy and 'Continue with Vera' hidden; radar below the rail; FROM label shown with a full-width select; checkbox moved onto the Send row; the row centred.
Codes removed: per-row numbers on Status and Settings, the Ideas # column, task #ids, the #ids in the Ideas radar and Status's waiting list.
Settings part names set as Plex 600 17px items with the summary in --dim. Lamps are matte dots in section inks. The Setup cell is now a contents line with an amber lamp.
Chat: initials are 2rem Plex discs (the kids' too). The composer is Home's slate box on the graphite deck, with no glass. From has its label and the focus ring.

Status: the slide rule was rebuilt across the main column as a horizontal glass sized to content: 21px VT323 labels all below the axis, ticks only at $0.01/$0.10/$0.50/$1.00/$2.00, a 1.5x lit needle, and a dashed ghost at the usual day. Only 'Who answers' keeps the lit figure.
Ideas: kind words coloured with each kind's --k ink; the # column dropped.
Row 0: the number is exempt from the blur, set at #eafff0 with an E13 bloom, and the rest of the line is at 55% phosphor. The month page is P400.
New idea form unboxed; Add it and Cancel share a height and a centre line. The Fastext 'Late' label's baseline was fixed.
Declined: label-over-field rows on the New idea form. I kept label-left ledger rows divided by hairlines, unboxed, because they read as contents lines and keep the form short.
Declined: shrinking the Ideas radar tube further. It already ends under its caption, and only the '#nn' codes inside it were removed.
crit: Home on the phone breaks the brief: Plans is not on the first or second screen. The case alone runs about 1500px (title, box, From row, full-width Send, Fastext 2x2, three starters, 'Continue with Vera'), and the fixed bottom nav covers 'Continue with Vera'. In the phone @media block (around sheet.css 1765), move the starters' .ways after the Plans section, or set them as one row of three short keys; drop .continue on the phone; and add padding-bottom to main equal to the bottom nav's height. On the phone the starters also lose their 'lands in' words and truncate to 'What should we do this we…': let the label wrap to two lines rather than ellipsize, and keep the icon. The phone From select also loses its 'FROM' label and sits 6px lower than the checkbox row: align the row with align-items:center.

Codes are back as costume on Status and Settings, the very fault the line lost on in 14a. Status rows carry 901-914 and Settings rows 991-999 (with 998 sorted first). Nobody navigates by these numbers, and the skeptic will read them as the old 'codes in the nav'. Remove the per-row folio spans from status.html and settings.html, keep the lamp, name, leader and state, and keep page numbers only in Row 0 and Home's Contents.

Three faces with jobs is broken on Settings and Chat. Settings rows set 'General', 'AI model' and the others in Fraunces at about 22px, which makes them rule heads posing as items: set them as items (Plex 600 17px, the brief's 'item 17/600') with the summary in --dim. In Chat, the speaker initials 'S' and 'A' are giant Fraunces glyphs floating outside the bubbles: give them the same 2rem initial disc Family uses (Plex 600 0.875rem, a 1px line ring) or drop them, since the bubble already says 'Sam'. Settings' row lamps are tiny grey dots: give each its section ink, as Home's Contents lamps have.

The Status slide rule is too small to read as the graft. The rule is about 240px inside the 18rem glass. '$0.01' sits above the axis while the other labels sit below it, and '$0.50 $1.00 $2.00' crowd and collide. At $0.00 the lit cursor and the ghost cursor both sit at the left edge and read as one blur. Fix: set every tick label on one side, below the axis, at 1rem VT323 or larger, with ticks only at $0.01, $0.10, $0.50, $1.00 and $2.00 (drop the minor ticks between $1 and $2). Draw the lit cursor as a 2px #6dff9c line 1.5x the ghost's height with a hot core, so it reads as the needle. Alternatively, run the rule across the right column under 'Spending today', so it gets about 500px. Size, don't stretch: the glass should end just under the rule.

Ideas page: the kind words in the table (Activity, Restaurant, Outing and the rest) are grey, though the brief and Home set each in its kind ink. Colour .kind text with the same per-kind token as the ring icon. The '#1-#12' column is another code column: make it --faint, or drop it now that names are links. Ideas stays the greenest page because of the tall radar tube in the side column. Size the tube to its content (it runs to about 800px) and end it under the 'North at the top' caption.

Chat's box is still a tube around a slate field, so it is not Home's box. Make the composer what Home has: the slate field (#0c100e, 1px #323a36, radius 6px) on the graphite deck with no glass and scanlines around it, with the From select, the checkbox and Send on one row under it. Give the From select the E5 focus ring the brief asks for. That makes 'one kind of box looks one way everywhere' true on the page where people type most.

Row 0's page number does not read as white-hot in the stills. 'P300' shows as a dull grey-green chip with a dark box behind it, because .row0 > span{filter: blur(0.3px)} applies to .r0-no as well and the layered shadow smears to a pill. Exempt .r0-no from the blur, set its colour to a near-white core (#eafff0) with the E13 bloom, and step 'FamilyDB · Ideas' down to about 55% phosphor, so the number is the one lit thing on the line. On the month page, 'P410 · Plans · Month' invents a sub-number: use 'P400', with 'Month' as the name.

Forms and the remaining boxes. The New idea form is still a boxed cell grid, and Settings' 'Setup' side panel is a filled cell, against the line's unboxed system. Put the form under a rule head ('New idea' fields as label-over-field rows divided by hairlines, no outer box), and set Settings' Setup as a contents line with an amber lamp under the tube. On the form, 'Add it' and 'Cancel' differ in height and baseline (Cancel sits about 3px lower): give both buttons the same min-height and align-items:center in the action row. On Home, the Fastext 'Late' label sits about 2px below 'Plans', 'To do' and 'Ideas' because of its lamp: set .fx-label to line-height 1 with the lamp's vertical-align centred, or make .fx align-items:center.

firstDraft.name: Folio, Fastext
firstDraft.concept: The service is still a teletext magazine of numbered pages, but now the numbering sits where teletext put it. Each inner page opens on a lit Row 0 on dark glass, with a white-hot page number. Home is one cased headline: the title on scanlined glass, a slate box under it, the ways to start as contents lines, and a Fastext row of four keys in grounded section inks. Below it sit unboxed sections under rule heads, and one two-column Contents list. It should feel like a calm, well-set magazine where the machine's light shows only on the glass, the lamps, the NOW lines and the one lit word.
